# tailor_aigateway (Resource)

The aigateway resource represents an AI Gateway in Tailor.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_namespace` (String) The Auth namespace under which workspace auth resolves request tokens for this AI Gateway.
- `name` (String) The name of the AI Gateway. Must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,28}[a-z0-9]$`. Forms part of the customer-facing domain and cannot be changed after creation.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the workspace that the AI Gateway belongs to.

### Optional

- `cors` (List of String) Allowed CORS origins for browser-based clients. Each entry is one of:
`*` (any origin), `http(s)://*`, `http(s)://*.example.com`, or `http(s)://app.example.com`.
An optional `:port` may be appended. Empty list disables cross-origin access.
- `disabled` (Boolean) When true, the AI Gateway stops serving traffic. Flip back to false to resume. Defaults to false.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels for this AI Gateway.

### Read-Only

- `domain` (String) The computed customer-facing domain of the AI Gateway (`<name>-<workspace_hash>.<base_domain>`).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource.
- `url` (String) The computed customer-facing URL of the AI Gateway (`https://<domain>`).
